description: PROP-203b's Tool/Method column instructs the Phase-3 adversary to do a 'structural read of the diff to runtime/loop/prompt.mjs (if touched) confirming no added steering/ranking text, only the already-existing "you decide" framing.' I read the CURRENT /Users/anicca/anicca/runtime/loop/prompt.mjs directly (lines 69-119): the pre-existing baseline is NOT a neutral 'you decide' framing at all. It already contains explicit, forceful ranking/steering text: '## ★COLONY BOOTSTRAP PRIORITY (this period)★ ... your FIRST action this wake MUST be economy/gig ... Do this BEFORE hl_trade / yield / anything else', 'Prefer this over re-yielding surplus', and '## MINDSET: yield is the bank (done once). Value is CREATED by SELLING + TRADING + BUILDING ... it is almost never "yield again"'. verification-architecture.md's characterization of this file's baseline as neutral 'you decide' framing is factually inaccurate and would mislead a fresh-context Phase-3 adversary relying on this document as ground truth: they might diff only the NEW lines this increment adds (correctly finding no new ranking text) while never being prompted to notice that the EXISTING file already violates the spirit of REQ-203's own stated design principle (a project-wide 'hard rule' that 'the model -- not hardcoded regex/if-else -- makes judgment calls' and that only 'the objective, numeric option space' should ever be narrowed by code, never 'steering text that tells the model WHICH of the remaining options to prefer'). Since REQ-203 leans on this principle as already generally true in this codebase to justify why the NEW gate is compliant, and the document's own verification tool description asserts the pre-existing baseline supports that claim, a Phase-3 reviewer following this instruction literally is being set up to under-scrutinize a real, pre-existing violation of the same principle in the very file this increment touches.

evidence.snippet: ## ★COLONY BOOTSTRAP PRIORITY (this period)★\n- ... your FIRST action this wake MUST be economy/gig: post ONE real bounded sub-task ... Do this BEFORE hl_trade /\n  yield / anything else.
